description: Minimal, honest documentation record for a computational model referenced by TSM evidence. Describes what the model is for, what it cannot do, and how it is overseen. This document describes the model; it does not certify compliance, safety, accuracy, or legal adequacy of any kind.

evaluation_summary.description: Optional summary of how the model has been evaluated (data, metrics, known error bounds). Descriptive only.

human_oversight_required.description: Per the stewardship charter, technology informs people; it does not silently govern people. Human authority remains final, so this is always true.

intended_use.description: What the model is designed to be used for. Screening and planning-support language only; a stated use is not a permit determination or regulatory finding.

limitations.description: Known limitations and out-of-scope uses. At least one limitation must be stated; no model is limitation-free.

lineage.description: Optional provenance of the model: training data sources, code repositories, predecessor versions.

model_version.description: Version identifier of the model this card describes.

title: TSM Model Card
